d: We are hiring an ETL Engineer to design, build and run our data integration layer on Microsoft Fabric and deliver trusted, high-performance Power BI reporting to the business. You will report to the Head of IT and work with data analysts, application owners and business stakeholders.
q: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or a related field.
3–5 years of hands-on experience in ETL/ELT development and data warehousing.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Factory / Synapse.
Strong SQL (T-SQL) and Python or PySpark.
Power BI expertise: semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query and report design.
Good English; Arabic is an advantage.
Microsoft certifications: DP-600, DP-700 or PL-300.
Experience with Delta Lake, Purview and Azure DevOps.
Experience migrating legacy ETL (SSIS, Informatica) to Fabric.
r: Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, PySpark/SQL notebooks).
Ingest data from on-premises and cloud sources, with incremental loads, logging and error handling.
Build Lakehouse and Warehouse layers in OneLake (bronze/silver/gold) with star-schema models.
Develop Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, dashboards and paginated reports with row-level security.
Tune performance and manage deployment pipelines.
Implement data quality checks, security and documentation; monitor pipelines and resolve failures within SLA.
Manage source control and CI/CD (Git, Azure DevOps or GitHub).
